Straight version, no smoothing:

Priya's is the real thing here — and it's actually two problems, not one. The backlog stress is one, but "I raised it and didn't feel heard" is a separate issue about whether the team's actually listening, and that one matters more long-term. That shouldn't get diluted just because two other people didn't echo it.

Riley saying things feel fine is worth taking at face value — it's his read, not evidence that Priya's read is wrong. One person's fine doesn't cancel another person's not-fine; they're just both true at once.

Marcus not saying much — I'd flag that it's unusual, not what it means. I don't know if that's "nothing to add" or "checked out of the conversation," and I'm not going to guess. Worth someone asking him directly rather than reading into the silence.

So the honest shape of this: one real, named piece of friction from Priya that deserves a direct follow-up (the backlog and the not-being-heard part, separately), one person doing fine, one open question mark on Marcus. Not a "great retro, team's solid" wrap-up — that'd be papering over the one thing that actually needs attention.
